import random
random.seed(42)
ok = True
def check(name, dist, lo, hi, pts=5):
    global ok
    X = dist
    for _ in range(pts):
        v = random.uniform(lo, hi)
        d = simplify(diff(cdf(X)(Symbol('z', positive=True)), Symbol('z', positive=True)).subs(Symbol('z', positive=True), v) - density(X)(v))
